items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Yes, he's a guitar player, along in my class. But Linus, I mean, put both of us in the sewer.

ctx.x: I'm always conscious of what I'm doing. How's the thing you had on the guitar with all those strings?
I have, have you ever heard young Linus McLean play the guitar? Yes, not very much.
